title: A sandwiched ventricular explant assay to model mouse coronary angiogenesis ex vivo
protocol: Collect E12.5 left ventricles under a dissection microscope from BmxCreER;R26fsGFP mouse embryos.
Isolate hearts using autoclaved scissors and forceps and collect in cold DPBS.
Check the hearts’ GFP expression under a fluorescent microscope to confirm BmxCreER;R26fsGDP labeling of endocardial cells.
Dissect out the left ventricle from the heart using fine forceps.
Hold the heart on the bottom of a 60mm Petri dish with one forceps and dissect the left ventricle with another forceps.
Place the left ventricles in cold DPBS on ice for no longer than 2 hours.
Make the Matrigel media freshly on ice.
Add 150 μL of Matrigel media per well to a 4-well dish using a precooled (4°C) pipette.
Incubate the Matrigel media-coated 4-well dish in a 37°C 5% CO2 cell culture incubator for 25-30 minutes to allow polymerization.
Optimize the incubation time for good ventricular explant culture.
Pipette 1 to 3 left ventricles in DPBS using a 3 mL transfer pipette.
Place the left ventricles in one well of a Matrigel media coated 4-well dish with the cutting side facing down.
Gently remove excess DPBS from the wells using a 20 μL pipette.
Add 150 μL of Matrigel media to each well and incubate for 30 minutes at 37°C in a 5% CO2 cell culture incubator.
Add 200 μL of ventricular explant culture Basal Media supplemented with 2 ng/mL TGFb2 per well.
Culture the left ventricles in a 37°C 5% CO2 cell culture incubator for one day, which is considered day 0.
On day 1 and day 2, carefully remove the whole conditional media 1 using a 100 μL pipette.
Replace with fresh conditional media 1 for two days.
Alternatives:
Add 200 μL of ventricular explant culture Basal Media supplemented with 10 ng/mL TGFb2 per well.
Culture the left ventricles in a 37°C 5% CO2 cell culture incubator for one day, which is considered day 0.
On day 1 and day 2, carefully remove the whole conditional media 2 using a 100 μL pipette.
Replace with fresh Basal Media for two days.
On the day 3, switch to ventricular explant culture Basal Media supplemented with 10 ng/mL VEGF120 (Conditional media 7).
Carefully change the culture media every other day.
Change to fresh conditional media 7 on the day 5 and day 7 for another 6 days.
Take images of cultured left ventricles under the fluorescent microscope on day 3, 6, and 9.
